entries.commercial_impact: Public positioning and historical maturity statements may remain cached or copied.

entries.commercial_impact: Machine-readable entry may have exposed workflow and repository surface descriptions.
entries.recommended_action: Keep private canonical entry; prepare only reviewed, reconstructed discovery metadata.

entries.commercial_impact: Community positioning and contribution claims may have been indexed.
entries.recommended_action: Preserve as historical exposure; publish no replacement until reviews are complete.

entries.commercial_impact: Contribution workflow details may be reusable outside the private core.
entries.recommended_action: Classify and reconstruct a bounded public contribution guide only after legal, security and commercial review.

entries.commercial_impact: Operational state, governance gates and historical identifiers reveal internal program posture.
entries.recommended_action: Never export the canonical live state; derive a separately reviewed public status summary.

entries.commercial_impact: Draft protocol names and maturity metadata may have been copied.
entries.recommended_action: Export only explicitly approved protocol entries through publication-by-reconstruction.

entries.commercial_impact: Core validation logic and boundary checks are implementation know-how.
entries.recommended_action: Do not export; expose only black-box conformance results or a separately authored client contract.

entries.commercial_impact: Failure handling, persistence and model-response validation are private implementation details.
entries.recommended_action: Do not export; describe behavior only through the private customer API contract.
